Find articles and pages across your publications’ editions with the
prebuilt search screen.
A standalone view controller for displaying publication archives.
Provides a paywall view controller displayed when attempting to open
an edition from a search result.
Set the prebuilt UI’s appearance and behavior once, globally, and override it where a screen needs something different.
A view controller protocol used by the SDK to present paywalls when
accessing restricted content.
The edition identifier.
Optional delegate used for handling paywall interactions within the SDK. Without it, paywalls are not displayed.
Play videos and customize PDF hotspots in the prebuilt reader, which opens
the images, embeds, and links in edition pages itself.
The application (publication) identifier.
Know which identifier you have, where it comes from, and where it goes.
GUID of the publication this edition belongs to. The property
keeps the identifier’s historical name; the docs call it the
publication GUID.
Embed digital newspaper and magazine editions in your iOS app. Use PageSuite’s prebuilt reader, or build your own interface on the same engine.
Read articles aloud in the prebuilt reader with the SDK’s text-to-speech
provider, or bring your own voice, text, and audio controls.
Optional delegate responsible for handling paywall interactions for content
accessed via the carousel. If set, the SDK uses this delegate to present paywalls
when accessing premium or protected content.
Provides a paywall view controller displayed when attempting to
download an edition on PageSuite’s current system.
A standalone view controller for displaying bookmarked pages and articles.
Let users save articles and pages from the prebuilt reader, and reopen them from a Bookmarks screen, even offline.
A complete reader app you configure: edition archives, the reader, downloads, bookmarks, and search, styled to match your brand.
Provides a paywall view controller displayed when attempting to open
an edition on PageSuite’s current system, classic PDF or responsive.
Forward what users open, view, save, and search in the prebuilt UI to
your analytics provider.
